title: Decoding Inside Information
one_line: Separating 'routine' insiders (trade in the same month every year, ~55% of trades) from 'opportunistic' ones: opportunistic trades earn ~82 bps/month value-weighted abnormal returns, routine trades ~0.

findings.statement: Opportunistic-insider strategy: 82 bps/month VW abnormal return; routine ≈ 0.
Opportunistic trades predict firm news and events.
